correctness.rationale: The resultant of two missing-moment Hankel minors yields (ad-bc)F; direct moment substitutions and a rank-three secant parametrization show F defines the irreducible threefold. The triangular isomorphism on e=1 gives \(F=h(w^2+2cz^2)-z^3\), whose derivatives have common zero set exactly z=w=0. Homogeneous derivatives separately yield precisely two boundary lines. Three cubics cut out the projective closure of the affine graph set-theoretically; their (3,3) complete intersection with two multiplicity-one residual planes proves degree 9-1-1=7. The generic quadratic Hessian has rank two, establishing a nodal transverse germ and failure of R1. The separately executable exact SymPy checker verifies symbolic identities, a generic seven-point slice and finite-field instances; the infinite assertions depend on the written proof, not sampling.

value.rationale: Projected rational normal monomial quintics naturally lie beyond the 4-very-ample secant-normality setting; understanding the geometric source of nonnormality is motivated. An entire irreducible rational septic divisor with two boundary lines is a nontrivial, complete geometric classification, and the generic nodal transverse type explains failure of R1; neither the sextic degree nor common secant formulas imply these invariants. It is a meaningful standalone structural result without claims about the Jacobian thickening.
